text.guided: Your laser came out the same length, but it points somewhere else. An eigenvector is about **direction**: the exit ray must lie on the same line as the laser. It may be longer or shorter (even reversed), but it must not be turned.
text.fast: Eigen means same line, not same length: Mv = λv for some scalar λ.

scene.caption: A reflection keeps the length but turns it to (0, 1): not an eigenvector
